Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is a classic AP-MS (Affinity Purification Mass Spectrometry) workflow using DDA and LFQ to identify the interactome of Complement Factor H (FH). While the results discuss the ubiquitin-proteasomal pathway (UPS), there is no evidence of ubiquitin-remnant enrichment (diGly/K-GG) used in the MS assay itself; the UPS findings are based on the identity of the interacting proteins.

scope: To obtain mechanistic insight into the function of intracellular FH in hTERT-RPE1 cells, we analyzed the interactome of FH via immunoprecipitation followed by mass spectrometry-based analysis.
Immunoprecipitation was performed using an anti-FH antibody (200 µg/mL; clone C18/3, sc-47685, Santa Cruz, CA, USA) or immunoglobulin G (200 µg/mL; Santa Cruz, CA, USA) as a control.
In order to identify intracellular binding partners of FH, we performed FH immunoprecipitation (IP) followed by mass-spectrometry-based analysis (Figure 4a).
